name: DH-01 | Contract Intake & Registration
description:
# DH-01 | Contract Intake & Registration

**📋 Ticket:** [DH - DealRoom contract analysis](https://brightdata-group.monday.com/boards/8667788707/views/224418520/pulses/12251055162)
**🔗 Board:** brightdata-group.monday.com/boards/8667788707

---

**TRIGGER:** New file in Google Drive intake folder

**PURPOSE:** Registers uploaded contracts, resolves the Salesforce quote, assigns a BRT contract ID.

**FLOW:**
1. Parse filename → extract Salesforce ID (Opportunity `006...` or Quote `0Q0...`) + validate
2. Generate BRT contract ID (from `contract_seq`)
3. Salesforce lookup → resolve syncing Quote (`IsSyncing=true`) → quote_id, account_id, account_name, opportunity_id
4. Rename Drive file → `{BRT}_{customer}_{...}`
5. Insert into `dealhub.contract_registry` (status=REGISTERED)
6. Invalid filename → `@channel` error to intake channel

**DB:** `dealhub.contract_registry`
**DOWNSTREAM:** triggers DH-03 (legal) + DH-04 (CRO)

input.code:
fname   = input['filename'].to_s
next_id = input['next_id'].to_s
contract_id = "BRT" + next_id

ext  = fname[/\.[^.]+\z/].to_s
base = fname.sub(/\.[^.]+\z/, '')

id_part, label, rest = base.split('_', 3)
id_part    = id_part.to_s.strip
label_part = label.to_s.strip
rest_part  = rest.to_s.strip

# valid Salesforce ID: 006 (Opportunity) or 0Q0 (Quote) prefix + exactly 15 or 18 chars
id_valid = id_part.match?(/\A(006|0Q0)[A-Za-z0-9]{12}([A-Za-z0-9]{3})?\z/) &&
           (id_part.length == 15 || id_part.length == 18)

id_type = if !id_valid then 'invalid'
          elsif id_part.start_with?('006') then 'opportunity'
          else 'quote'
          end

# build the exact SOQL WHERE clause based on type (no OR, no malformed-Id risk)
where_clause = case id_type
               when 'opportunity' then "OpportunityId = '#{id_part}' AND IsSyncing = true"
               when 'quote'       then "Id = '#{id_part}'"
               else                    "Id = null"   # never runs (blocked by id_valid IF)
               end

def clean(s); s.to_s.gsub(/[\\\/:*?"<>|\[\]{}%#]/, '').strip; end
safe_label = clean(label_part)
safe_rest  = clean(rest_part)
safe_ext   = ext.empty? ? '.docx' : ext

new_filename = "#{contract_id}_#{safe_label}_#{safe_rest}#{safe_ext}"[0, 150]

{
  'contract_id'       => contract_id,
  'id_part'           => id_part,
  'id_type'           => id_type,        # opportunity | quote | invalid
  'id_valid'          => id_valid,
  'where_clause'      => where_clause,   # ready SOQL WHERE
  'label'             => safe_label,
  'rest_filename'     => safe_rest,
  'new_filename'      => new_filename,
  'original_filename' => fname
}
